_comment: Per-object grip force in raw FSR counts (3.3k divider). GRIP closes until the AVERAGE of both jaws reaches 'target'; if EITHER jaw goes above 'max' the jaws back off at once. Measured Nov 22: a firm hold on a ~40-46 mm object averages ~300 (the jaw nearer the object reads 2-4x the other); force rises ~70-100 counts per servo degree after contact. Tune the egg first.
